name: South Sudan
summary: Black, red and green horizontal bands edged in white, with a blue triangle at the hoist bearing a yellow star. Based on the flag of the Sudan People's Liberation Movement, it became the national flag at independence in 2011.
origin: The Sudan People's Liberation Movement (SPLM) used the flag during the Second Sudanese Civil War (1983–2005). After the 2005 peace agreement it became the flag of autonomous Southern Sudan.
South Sudan became independent from Sudan on 9 July 2011, the world's newest UN member state, and kept the flag.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: Peace attained after years of struggle.

symbols.name: Star of Bethlehem
symbols.description: A yellow five-pointed star in the blue triangle.
symbols.meaning: The unity of the states of South Sudan; called the Star of Bethlehem in official descriptions.

facts: It has six colours, as many as South Africa's flag.
Kenya's flag also uses black, red and green with white edging.
South Sudan is the newest UN member state, admitted in 2011.
clues: Black, red and green bands edged in white, with a blue hoist triangle and a yellow star.
The flag of the newest UN member state.
Its blue triangle stands for a great river.
